meta.purpose: pgvector per-query recall decomposition, LanceDB parity. Records recall_A_vs_exact / recall_B_vs_exact per query and splits each cell into the equal-recall and unequal-recall subsets.
script_changes: engine_matched2_pg.py: added per_query_recall(); compare() now takes an optional `exact` and appends recall_A_vs_exact / recall_B_vs_exact to every per-episode record (omitted when exact is None; the only call site, run_pg_floor, now passes exact). No other field or semantic changed.

rerun.floor: genuine re-measurement on PostgreSQL 17.4 + pgvector 0.8.0, port 5439; 3 seeds x 3 pass-pairs x 200 episodes; same protocol as engine_matched2_pg.py.
rerun.sweeps_and_controls: re-derived from the stored raw top-10 in results_engine_multiseed.json (the source of the paper's aggregates); aggregate tear reproduced exactly, only per-query fields are new. See raw_top10-key note.

meta.raw_top10_key_note: The ef-sweep ef=64 answer is read from A_idorder_rebuild_efc64_ef64: A_idorder_efc64_ef64 is later overwritten by the efc-sweep efc=64 rebuild, so it no longer holds the ef-sweep's ef=64 list.  Verified by tear reproduction.
meta.decomposition_convention: For each query, eq := (recall_A_vs_exact == recall_B_vs_exact). tear_all = any-difference rate over all 200 episodes (the paper's quantity); tear_eq = same over the eq subset; tear_ne = same over the ne subset (mechanically 1.0); frac_unequal = n_ne / n.
